sql: SELECT "Reservations"."Room" AS e, "Rooms"."bedType" AS g, AVG("Reservations"."Rate") AS m1, AVG((CAST(("Reservations"."Kids" - "Reservations"."Adults") AS REAL) / "Reservations"."Adults")) AS m2 FROM "Reservations" JOIN "Rooms" ON "Rooms"."RoomId" = "Reservations"."Room"  GROUP BY "Reservations"."Room", "Rooms"."bedType" ORDER BY m2 DESC LIMIT 10
quantities: Reservations.relative difference of number of children from number of adults
why: average of nightly rate charged per Rooms within Rooms.bedType
(number of children - number of adults) / number of adults: the relative difference of two quantities in count
average of relative difference of number of children from number of adults per Rooms within Rooms.bedType
